title: Understanding Thresholds
text: When you increase the threshold in a classification model, you are essentially making it harder for the model to classify a positive instance. This can affect precision, recall, and accuracy.

title: Effect on Precision
text: Precision is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total positive predictions (true positives + false positives). Increasing the threshold can reduce false positives, potentially increasing precision.

title: Effect on Recall
text: Recall is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total actual positives (true positives + false negatives). Increasing the threshold can increase false negatives, potentially decreasing recall.

title: Effect on Accuracy
text: Accuracy is the ratio of correct predictions (true positives + true negatives) to the total number of predictions. Increasing the threshold can affect both false positives and false negatives, impacting accuracy.

title: Analyzing Accuracy
text: Consider how changes in false positives and false negatives affect the overall accuracy of the model. Can accuracy decrease when the threshold is increased?
